Priors.description:
Prior overrides by model parameter; unset parameters keep their defaults.

Each parameter accepts only distributions with the right support (a media effect is
positive, an adstock decay lies in (0, 1)) and only the dims it may vary over, so
the control plane rejects a wrong prior from the JSON Schema alone.

beta_channel.description: Typical (median across geos) effect of each channel at full saturation

beta_sigma.description: Log-scale spread of a channel's effect across geos (partial pooling)

gamma_control.description: Coefficient of each control feature (seasonality, holidays, ...)

intercept.description: Population mean of the geo intercepts (model units: the target is mean-scaled)

intercept_sigma.description: Spread of the geo intercepts around their population mean

lam.description: Logistic saturation rate (per unit of scaled spend)

theta.description: Delayed adstock: periods until the peak effect

settings_schema.description:
Settings of ``mmm.hierarchical_geo``.

Canonical names (bind dataset names to these in ``data.bind``): dims ``geo``,
``channel`` and ``time``; target ``y``; spend ``spend`` as a lag tensor over
``lag_dim`` (``core.lag_tensor``). Every other numeric variable along ``time`` is a
control (or list them in ``controls``).

manifest.description: Tabular quantile regression for panels such as store x sku x week demand: rows are stacked from labelled dims, coordinates become categorical features, new levels are pooled and forecasts are direct. Quantiles are per cell and never aggregated.

y_hat.description: Conditional quantiles of the target over the row dims

ColumnsSettings.description:
Which variables become feature columns.

``vars`` (explicit list) wins over ``roles``; ``exclude`` removes names from either.
Variables with dims beyond ``rows`` are flattened into one column per label
(``spend[tv]``, ``promo_lag[1]``).
ColumnsSettings.title: ColumnsSettings

QuantileUncertainty.description:
Conditional quantiles (representation ``quantiles``).

xgboost fits one native multi-quantile model; sklearn's quantile-capable estimators fit
one model per level. ``rearrange`` sorts crossing quantiles per cell (monotone
rearrangement), which never makes the pinball loss worse.
QuantileUncertainty.title: QuantileUncertainty
